text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp.
Mejiro Ryan also had a few encounters that seemed like they could spark... love? However...

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, so you're an Umamusume.
Would you say your ears are your best charm point?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No... um... it's the hamstrings!
They can even repel small pebbles, you know?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer A
text_block_list.text: H-Hamst...?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer B
text_block_list.text:
Um! Want to do fireworks together?
Can I come pick you up tonight?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes... Then midnight, please...

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, if it's that late,
won't we run out of time for fireworks...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Aren't these things supposed
to happen right at midnight...?

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer C
text_block_list.text: Let's play a game, a game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Is it that thing?
Where the first one to confess loses!

text_block_list.name: Beachgoer C
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of a rather baffling conversation,
Mejiro Ryan kept digging her own grave.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After suffering one crushing defeat after another,
Mejiro Ryan was completely worn out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...
I'm like a kindergartner when it comes to romance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather have been properly hated, at least...
Being treated like some total weirdo is just a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm bad at it,
it just naturally ended up like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Because McQueen was there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, the name of her lifelong rival came up
even here. Saying nothing, I listened intently to her story.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't it pathetic? Challenging someone head-on only to lose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen is super cute, and her outfits are totally stylish and popular...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when I wanted to wear dresses
and tie my hair with ribbons, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But... I stand no chance...
I'll just lose for sure and get hurt...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I gave up on it. I figured if comparing myself to others
just makes me depressed, I'm better off not doing it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Throw away everything except sports. Cut your hair short, and devote yourself entirely to strength training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that,
I got beaten in running too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What a tragic childhood.
I instinctively pat their shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's so unfair, isn't it? Having such a super-pretty girl
right next to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, I couldn't resent them...
I couldn't bring myself to hate them. Because..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because I loved McQueen.
Because I looked up to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you can't even call something lovely when it is,
then you really have nothing left.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when pushed into a corner, she holds her ground till the very end.
That must be the source of Mejiro Ryan's strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... is it too late for me?
To make my... 'romance makeup' debut now, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Do I really have no choice but to devote my whole life to muscles?
Like, 'muscle or die' style?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I know I can take it all back, piece by piece.
Just like how I made it in time for the Classics."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I encourage her, saying, "You'll find plenty of wonderful romances"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so what should I do next?!
I'm all ears!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please tell me!
What am I lacking? What's the secret to being good at romance!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Proper knowledge... Ugh, you're right...
All I know is secondhand stuff from romance manga...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Understood! I'll try reading all kinds of books during this training camp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Mejiro Ryan spent every night devouring how-to books about romance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mumu, mumumu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... Mmmgh-gh-gh-gh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh, I had no idea such a rule existed!
Talk about an eye-opener!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with unfamiliar knowledge, her body blazes fiercely.
Embarrassment has transformed into raw power!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
S-So you're saying I should just stay quiet and listen?
Like being a good listener, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, I'm so fidgety I feel like I'm gonna explode, but I'll give that strategy a shot tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, just wait! When someone talks to you,
all you have to do is listen and nod...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *gasp* You're such a good listener—!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet, not yet!
Good listener, good listener, good listener!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, it's already night?!
Why didn't anyone say anything to me?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When she was standing there so heroically,
there was no way I could bring myself to call out to her.
Still, enduring it gave me some real guts.
